items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I go to work that afternoon at three o'clock at Dreamland and then Hershey Miller's sitting up there on the terrace reading it.

ctx.x: What did Hershey Miller and Nails do? Well, they're gunmen, I guess. They were?

You know, in gang war. You know how they do. Were they pretty big time? Well they must have been, because they didn't, not one of them served a day for that. They show you what kind of town Chicago it was. The papers, it was on a Sunday morning. I'm pretty sure it was on a Sunday morning. They come out with an extra. They said they were, uh, a hundred, one thousand dollars or something like that, and wasn't booked. You know? The bonds, you know? Yeah.
